name: lsqnonlin
comment: Sig: [p,resnorm,residual,exitflag]=lsqnonlin(fun,p0); lsqcurvefit(fun,p0,x,y). Nonlinear least squares via embedded-.m Levenberg-Marquardt (forward-diff Jacobian, same Gauss-Newton/LM core as fsolve but terminates at the LSQ minimiser so it handles over-determined residuals). lsqcurvefit = lsqnonlin(@(p) fun(p,x)-y, p0). Pausable residual (bytecode). Parity on the SOLUTION: well-determined params + resnorm. NOTE the a*exp(b*x) fit (crn) has a FLAT minimum so its params are loosely determined (numkit vs MATLAB land ~1e-5 apart) but the RESNORM is tight — fingerprint uses crn (resnorm=0.001248164767), not c's params. Exact-param cases fingerprinted directly: lsqnonlin linear -> [1 2] resnorm 0, Rosenbrock -> [1 1], lsqcurvefit noise-free sin -> [2 1.5]. Bounds (lb/ub) deferred (rejected). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes bugs/optim/nonlinear-lsq.
